52271.author: PeiZhuLai
52271.body:
backport of #52268
to 14_0_X. It adds `MCZllMesonPhotonFilter`, a HepMC-based
generator filter for Drell-Yan samples, with the same code as in master.
No existing code is changed.

#### PR validation:

Built in CMSSW_14_0_25. 20000 Pythia8 Z+jet  ee/ events were filtered in the same job with
this module and with the private version used for our current samples, modified to
use the same fixed cluster axis: both keep the same events (2455 pass both, 0 pass only
one of them).

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #52268. HIG needs the filter in the RunIII2024Summer24 campaign, for the
central production of the DY background samples of the HZ analysis.
52271.title: [14_0_X] Add MCZllMesonPhotonFilter to GeneratorInterface/GenFilters

52369.author: makortel
52369.body:
#### PR description:

This PR backports https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911 as requested in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/47050#issuecomment-6069544996 . To make the backport more straightforward the following additional cleanup PRs are included
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47914
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49134
* https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49430

The diffs of these 3 PRs applied cleanly on 14_0_X (whereas the #50911 did not). Therefore I'd suggest to focus the review effort to compare the last commit of this PR to the content of #50911.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2482

#### PR validation:

Code compiles.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/47914, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49134, https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/49430, and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50911. Backports to 14_1_X - 16_1_X (to satisfy policy) to be done after the review of this PR finishes.
52369.title: [14_0_X] Clean up InputFileCatalog (including rfio, TrivialFileCatalog) and reduce its memory usage
